svg.text: Every component, all four trust zones, every data flow. “(designed)” = in the design, not built in the PoC.
outside our control: people, the model provider, third parties, the documents agents read
namespace agentorch · Pod Security restricted · default-deny NetworkPolicy
the only code that ever holds a plaintext credential
one txn commits log + state + journal + audit
namespace agentorch-sandboxes · tainted node pool · no SA token
OIDC identity (API key in the PoC)
React SPA served by the control plane
sees ONLY tool schemas, never backend config
lease → replay log → one step → fenced commit
holds a run-scoped JWT (≤5 min) only
single choke point for the LLM
one bucket per tenant + shared spare pool
the only route out of a broker sandbox
not built in the PoC — see gaps
per-tenant HMAC roots · TTL ≤60 s (cap 10 min)
reload run + PINNED digest from store
DECIDE before any credential is touched
events (run_id, seq) append-only — the agent IS this
tool_calls idem_key PK · IN_FLIGHT | DONE | FAILED
Commit: lease fence + next_seq OCC, one txn
shared fairness buckets — limiter is per-process today
with local lease/batch to avoid a round trip per call
EMPTY network namespace: no iface up, no addr, no route → ENETUNREACH
pivot_root onto read-only tmpfs · synthesised /etc · /work + /tmp only writable
cgroup cpu/mem/pids + rlimits + wall-clock in the PARENT
prod: RuntimeClass gvisor · cold start 8.4 ms (ns) / 1–3 s (gVisor pod)
runs a TRUSTED binary from our image (gh, aoconvert) — never model code
separate pid + user namespace from the agent sandbox
GH_TOKEN in ITS environment only · same /work mounted
network: via egress proxy (PoC: host netns, labelled as weaker)
agent cannot: read its /proc/<pid>/environ · ptrace it · see it in ps
credential scrubbed from stdout as belt-and-braces
create run · read log · verify audit chain
POST /v1/toolcalls · run-scoped JWT · idem key run:step:i
API tool: the GATEWAY makes the call
exec tool: argv in, stdout out
What is deliberately ABSENT from this picture
• no arrow from agentd to any third party — NetworkPolicy agentd-egress permits Postgres + gateway only
• no arrow out of the AGENT SANDBOX — an empty network namespace has nowhere to route to
• no credential anywhere left of the TCB — workers and the control plane have never held one
